node.statement: Because C is a finite nonempty equivalence class, enumerate C={j_1,...,j_q}, where q=|C|>=1, and set U_r={j_1,...,j_r}. Node 1.2 gives the reset state on U_1. For each 1 <= r < q, instantiate node 1.3 with the exact state produced at index r (node 1.2 when r=1, and the single output selected by the immediately preceding instance of node 1.3 thereafter), U=U_r, and j=j_{r+1}; define the next state to be that instance's single selected output on U_{r+1}. Ordinary finite induction therefore produces a reset state at every U_r without any floating inductive hypothesis or change of witness within a step.
